text_blocks.snippet:
Class 4 impact-resistant shingles are a smart upgrade for Utah homes facing severe mountain weather, heavy winter snow, and spring hail. These shingles pass the strict UL 2218


test by resisting cracks from a 2-inch steel ball dropped from 20 feet. Many insurance companies in Utah may offer premium discounts for installing them.

references.snippet: IKO Nordic ArmourZone Asphalt Shingles (Brownstone) Heavyweight laminated asphalt shingles engineered for durability and fast installation. Nordic features IKO’s ArmourZone wide nailing area, Class 4 impact resistance, and a dimensional shake-look in the Brownstone colorway.
